Nigerians in Diaspora Organisation Europe has said that its leadership elections will be held on Saturday, November 13, 2027.
The organisation made this known in a statement signed by the Chairman, Chibuzo Ubochi and General Secretary, Dr Abimbola Oluwasina, made available to Diaspora Tales on Thursday.
According to the statement, “the confirmation follows the organisation’s Annual General Meeting, held on Saturday, 14 November 2026, with members participating in person and online.”
It stated that at the meeting, the General House approved that the Board of Trustees take responsibility for appointing the electoral committee and for setting its terms of reference.
“The Committee is mandated to prepare for the elections of and to discharge its duties independently, transparently and impartially, ensuring equal treatment of eligible members and chapters,” the statement offered.
“No leadership election took place at the AGM, and none was due. NIDO Europe continues under the leadership of Sir Barr Chibuzo Ubochi, Continental Chairman, and the serving Central Executive Council.”
At the meeting, NIDO Europe also resolved to join the other continental bodies in advancing the institutionalisation of the Nigerian global community. “The continental NIDO organisation is autonomous and equal in standing, responsible for its own governance under its own constitution,” it added.
